newsitem.title: USA: U Mich consumer sentiment 104.5 June final-sources.
newsitem.headline: U Mich consumer sentiment 104.5 June final-sources.

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for June rose to 104.5 compared to 103.2 in the final May report, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component fell to 113.2 in the final June report from 113.5 in the final May. The expectations index rose to 98.9 in the June final report versus 96.6 in the final May.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
